snippet.title: Expendabots - Exclusive Gameplay and Demo Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809820/Expendabots/
